lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 10 to 12 distinct vertical white lines of varying intensity; spacing is irregular, with wider gaps between anterior lines and more compressed intervals toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A visible bifurcation occurs on the 4th line from the anterior, splitting into a Y-shape at approximately mid-torso verticality.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Significant discontinuities observed in the 8th, 9th, and 10th lines, which terminate as abbreviated segments before reaching the ventral fringe.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low-density cluster of 3 distinct high-contrast white spots located on the upper-to-mid section of the posterior haunch.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate curvature with a spiral twist; the primary silhouette moves outward from the frontal bone at approximately a 55-degree angle before curving inward toward the apical tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal tips is approximately 3.8 times the pixel width of the left horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Bright ivory-colored tipping accounts for approximately 15% of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking between the eyes; horizontal white banding on the muzzle; multiple high-contrast white spots on the lower cheek; dark shaggy dorsal and ventral mane contrast with tan lower leg 'socks'.
